verdict.rationale: The official anthropics/skills repo documents in-agent marketplace commands: `/plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills` followed by `/plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills`. Claude Code docs state a plugin is installed and loaded as one unit, and that a marketplace is registered with one command and plugins are installed from it. A hands-on probe also confirmed a real one-line install of a skill from the repo via `npx skills add`, though that used third-party tooling. Missing for 10: the documented flow takes two steps (marketplace add, then install) rather than a single command, and there is no explicit documentation or hands-on evidence that installed skills become active in the next session.
